{"story":{"what":"Adds a [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] attribute, with an optional SurrogateType, to MessagePack.Annotations. When the attribute is on a partial class that implements IMessagePackFormatter<T>, the source generator writes the formatter body into that class and registers it in the generated resolver. T is read in contractless mode (public read-write instance members, keyed by name as strings) or through the [Key]/[IgnoreMember] annotations of a surrogate type that is matched to T by member name and type. Four new diagnostics, MsgPack019 to MsgPack022, are reported for misuse. New execution tests use a separate ExternalTypes project that has no MessagePack reference.","why":"Requirement MP-2129 asks for source-generated formatters for types declared in a referenced library that has no MessagePack attributes or reference.
